copy.audio/RECORDING_HANDOFF.md:
# Author recording handoff

Record reading-script.md for the complete ten-paragraph essay, or the named cut script for selected exact excerpts. Record at your natural pace; 24/45/60/120-second timings are provisional. Deliver an unprocessed mono WAV, preferably 48 kHz / 24 bit, plus room tone. No generated voice is used.

On receipt: edit pauses and scene holds to the recording, replace text-card timings with speech-aligned Vietnamese subtitles, translate/review English subtitles, duck ambience, and export the final mix. The current original synthetic 24-second tonal bed is looped in the cuts; it is not documentary location audio.
copy.docs/DESIGN_REVIEW.md:
# Design implementation

Teal, coral, sage and cream follow the supplied board. Six documented scene crops use only the supplied artwork. Paris/reunion imagery is omitted because it is absent from the essay. Thursday football follows the actual t5 text, overriding the Tuesday typo in one reference task. The demographic mock-chart is not republished as evidence.

The reader retains all ten author paragraphs and presents source notes separately. Currency Exchange switches between two perspectives and four everyday objects; it does not rate people or predict outcomes. Five social cards and five film formats select exact author excerpts. The films are provisional edits awaiting the author recording. PDF files are editorial proofs; native crop resolution limits print quality. The original board remains intact under references; the new board uses actual deliverables.
copy.social/BRIEF.md:
# Dating 102 social pack

Five 1080×1440 cards, three 1080×1920 stories, Facebook 1200×630, YouTube 1280×720, TikTok 1080×1920. The social sequence focuses on status, asking questions and being known; the chapter retains the full demographic argument with separate source notes. No numerical prediction or gender generalization is promoted as a verified finding.

Video: 24-second teaser, 60-second discovery, 45-second feed, and 120-second excerpts in portrait and landscape. All await author narration. No external social upload or scheduling has occurred.
